title: Condemnation is the damage engine
body: Hits only Chain of Torment targets; Earth Punishment at stigma 5 makes it always crit; at skill 12 a crit resets its cooldown. Half the damage on a KR meter.

title: A damage Cleric still owes the chest contribution
body: Chest needs 5% of the final boss's HP in damage or 20% of party damage healed (aion2.run, citing GamersTogether); a pure healer can leave with nothing.

title: Light of Protection doesn't stack with Undefeated Mantra
body: Only the stronger applies and the Chanter's Mantra wins a tie; with a Chanter in the group, slot Absolution instead.

title: Conflict: the fourth stigma for a damage Cleric
body: Prayer of Amplification (expcarry, playhub, aion2maps, aion2.run offensive) against Summon Resurrection (64% of top Clerics vs 50%) or Yustiel's Power (Antochi).

title: Conflict: Debilitating Mark in the damage loop
body: In the macro per playhub and expcarry, and a global dummy tester gains with it; Antochi and KR ranker data call casting it on cooldown a damage loss.

title: Conflict: does a macro entry fire a whole hotbar column?
body: Creators stack skills in one column and register only its row-0 skill (Antochi: 'one step, that column'); the 2026-10-10 in-game read took an entry as one skill.

title: Conflict: Bolt inside the macro
body: Th3Ruthless registers Bolt as an entry; Antochi, allthings.how and a BoredAF commenter keep it manual, since the macro fires it at charge 1.

title: Repeat Condemnation once the reset is live
body: Expcarry lists Condemnation several times in its boss macro to catch crit resets; worth it only once Condemnation reaches 12 with the reset spec.

title: Turn Skill Queue off for the Condemnation macro
body: BoredAF: with Skill Queue on, Condemnation doesn't go out properly; Antochi and expcarry say turn it on. Test both on the dummy.
